QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] Commence Operation
QuestInfo.0: Start the operation to enter Heliseum Downtown with #bPiston#k in the #bBlue Speeyor's Pasture#k.
QuestInfo.1:
Piston said to push the enemy troops hit by the Blue Dragon Cannon into the valley in front of Heliseum Downtown. Once there, start the operation. 

#r#e*If you fail, forfeit the quest and start over from the beginning.#k
QuestInfo.2: The Specters were driven into the valley in front of Heliseum Downtown as planned.
